title: Punjab Weights and Measures International System Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Weights and Measures International System Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE LIII OF 2002
PUNJAB WEIGHTS AND
MEASURES (INTERNATIONAL
SYSTEM)
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE LIII OF
2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Punjab Weights and
Measures (International System) Enforcement Act, 1975
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 23rd September, 2002]
No., Legis.13-44/2002, dated
23-9-2002.-----The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information:
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Punjab Weights and
Measures (International System) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Weights and Measures International System Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment in section 17 of Act LII of 1975

ORDINANCE LIII OF 2002
PUNJAB WEIGHTS AND
MEASURES (INTERNATIONAL
SYSTEM)
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE LIII OF
2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Punjab Weights and
Measures (International System) Enforcement Act, 1975
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 23rd September, 2002]
No., Legis.13-44/2002, dated
23-9-2002.-----The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information:
3. Amendment in section 17 of
Act LII of 1975.------In the said Act, in section 17--
(i) in subsection (1) the comma
and word "repairing" shall be deleted; and
(ii) after subsection (1) the
following explanation shall be added:--
"Explanation.--All
licences for repair issued by the Controller or Deputy Controllers (Weights and
Measures) shall be treated as cancelled. For maintaining healthy activities in
the repair field of weights and measures, the Controller may issue
necessary instructions as he deems
necessary and in the public interest."
